worker_code: runs predate 29cbf1f4: no MLX buffer-cache limit
units: seconds, dBFS and GB as reported by the measuring tools; sha256_16 = first 16 hex digits of the output WAV SHA-256

findings: Duration is a ceiling: instrumental cases ended at 19.7-29.2 s; lyric cases reached the requested 30 s or 60 s.
About 6x slower than real time. Each job is a fresh worker, so times include model load; load and inference share the preparing stage and mlx-audio prints no timings.
Process footprint exceeds the MLX active peak (MLX buffer cache); worker max_rss underestimates it. Not re-measured with the 4 GiB cache limit.
Both runs are byte-identical per case; the same-seed repeat (07 vs 01) is identical.
Durations are exact. Warm: 1.75 s per 30 s, 2.6 s per 60 s, 4.3 s per 120 s; first job 3.86 s.
3 of 10 cases clip (05, 08, 10): raw model output peaks up to 1.289 per the SA3 log, written as int16.
MLX peak not measurable from the worker: the SA3 script resets the peak counter.
